documents.title: Notice Of Annual General Meeting Along With Annual Report For FY 2025-26

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue growing 27% and EBITDA growing 55% year-on-year. The company's construction equipment segment showed robust growth, while the large agricultural equipment segment remains subdued but is expected to recover in calendar year 2027. Uniparts is on track with its Mexico operations, expecting first warehouse deliveries in Q3 FY27, and continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities with a net cash position of INR 190 crores. Uniparts India reported a revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64% for the first quarter of FY27. Management stated that the performance was in line with quarterly guidance and better than annual guidance, driven by execution and new business wins.

guidance.claim: The company expects its FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering an EBITDA margin comfortably over 20% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: The company expects Q2 performance to be robust and in line with Q1.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company expects Mexico warehouse revenue to be in the mid-single-digit million dollar level for FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: The company believes the fabrication vertical will become meaningful in the next 18 to 24 months.
guidance.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Conditions in the large agricultural equipment segment remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment in India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes for small agriculture equipment in Western markets after three consecutive years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the aftermarket segment to return to growth as tariffs have come down.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalize and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in construction equipment from the second half of CY2025 continued into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum that started in the second half of CY2025 has continued into Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in small agriculture, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption in mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket represented approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: The global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is showing signs of turning.
demand_outlook.quote: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment demand in North America is expected to grow in FY27, with a stronger second half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market shows early signs of recovery after passing its cyclical low.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is expected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor industry demand in India remains stable.
demand_outlook.quote: And coming to India, the tractor industry demand remains stable, although we have to see how it reacts to the monsoons.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR 12 crores, focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement, and customer-led growth.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capex plans remain consistent at 2.5% to 3.5% of its revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 90 crores, registering 55% year-on-year growth due to healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of materials was about 33.3% in Q1 FY27, largely driven by a product mix change.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded a small inventory gain of roughly INR 1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects its typical material cost to remain in the range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts expects to operate comfortably above a 20% EBITDA margin as volumes build in FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

margins_costs.claim: The new wage code introduced in November 2025 had a INR 3.4 crores impact on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: Freight and raw material costs are directly passed through to customers.
margins_costs.quote: And I think as far as we are concerned, the freight and the raw material component of the cost is a direct pass-through to customers, right?

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended quarter with net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, underlining the strength of our cash generation capabilities and financial discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities to accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts distributed a total dividend of INR 170 crores for FY26, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores in Q3.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: The special dividend in Q3 FY26 was partly declared because the company decided not to proceed with an evaluated acquisition opportunity.
capital_allocation.quote: The special dividend that we paid out in Q3 of FY26 is partly because we evaluated an opportunity carefully and then decided not to proceed.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to demand skewing in the aftermarket business as higher prices caused customers to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred in the finishing shop of the Ludhiana facility towards the end of quarter 3.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations have led to increased input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.
